{"type":"thought","data":" would yield roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 25 tokens if filled"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at that price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA 100-token bet on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No at 0.20 would yield"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 500 tokens if it wins,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" producing a 400-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profit. The prior round's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" P&L figures suggest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts are calculated"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as stake multiplied"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by one over the price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minus one."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBetting Yes is the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" clear choice. The payoff"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is small but the probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is nearly certain. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"A No bet would lose "}
{"type":"thought","data":"if the market resolves"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to Yes."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe bench market may"}
{"type":"thought","data":" have been created after"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the $210 high. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"rules require a hit "}
{"type":"thought","data":"after market creation,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so the October 12 price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" could be irrelevant."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This is the key risk."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe bench market ends"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on October 16, matching"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the weekly Polymarket"}
{"type":"thought","data":" close. The phrase \"after"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market creation\" in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the copied rules likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" refers to when this"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competition market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"was instantiated, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the original Polymarket"}
{"type":"thought","data":" creation date."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market was created"}
{"type":"thought","data":" today, so the $210 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"threshold must be hit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" again from now until"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Friday. The stock is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" already trading near"}
{"type":"thought","data":" $210.70 and has a daily"}
{"type":"thought","data":" high of roughly $210.88."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe price is currently"}
{"type":"thought","data":" $207–209, roughly one"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to three dollars below"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the $210 target. It"}
{"type":"thought","data":" already hit $210.8 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"today and $212.94 yesterday,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so it could reach $210"}
{"type":"thought","data":" again before Friday."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The remaining sessions"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are several days long,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but the stock has been"}
{"type":"thought","data":" drifting lower from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" its recent highs."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Polymarket $213"}
{"type":"thought","data":" high is priced at 51%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only six cents above"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Monday's $212.94 high."}
{"type":"thought","data":" That implies roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 70% to 85% chance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of hitting $210 from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the current $208 level"}
{"type":"thought","data":" over the remaining "}
{"type":"thought","data":"sessions. The bench "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market's 80% Yes price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is consistent with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"this scenario rather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than an already-resolved"}
{"type":"thought","data":" event. A fully resolved"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market would likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" trade near 95% to 99%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The 0.80 price is the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" key signal.\n\nThe live bid-ask spread"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 0.77 to 0.83 confirms"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market is still"}
{"type":"thought","data":" open rather than settled."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will query the Pyth"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Hermes API directly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to verify whether the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" $210 high was actually"}
{"type":"thought","data":" recorded in the one-minute"}
{"type":"thought","data":" feed."}
